title: 50% off Telstra nbn for 4 Months (500/50 $49/Mth, 750/50 $59/Mth, 1000/100 $64/Mth, New Services Only) @ Telstra
body:
Deal: 50% off Telstra nbn for 4 Months (500/50 $49/Mth, 750/50 $59/Mth, 1000/100 $64/Mth, New Services Only) @ Telstra

[edBARGAIN] damn i signed up to belong and its been 3 days they still haven't connected. how do i cancel my sign up to belong anyone got experience?
this telstra deal is better
[Sertacv2] Have you tried, gonna sound far-fetched, calling them?
[No Child Support] Calm down. It’s edBARGAIN, not edCOMMONSENSE
[sajuuk] Call Belong to cancel or go to your Belong account and get the AVC number and port to another ISP.
[wishing well] There's no lock-in with Belong right? If so just do the first month with them and sign up to Telstra on the 30th. Might cost $10 more but it pushes the discount out to 5 months and you likely get the $80 Belong bonus sim.
[BargainsGrabber] Better than their normal 2 months promo lol
[Fredfloresjr] 4 months not enough to remind you to get rid?
[Daabido] In four months reset your computer clock to November. Infinite glitch.
[pn09] 4 months half price is better than the usual offers of $20 - $30 off for 6 months that other ISPs do
[HardQuiz] This is tempting, but will mess up my usual 6 months churn during BF/CM deals for 2027.
[gakko] Comes with a complimentary Telstra ball gag
[Slo20] Anyone know if you can set a future date just before 30th November and if so how far in advance you can set.
[FerreroRocher] 30 days in advance. I went through the signup process now just to answer you.
[Slo20] You’re a a gem. Thank you. I got half way through signing up to find out but stopped once it was asking for all my ID.
That will work perfectly for me as my current 6 month deal ends first week of January.
[vovka] Tel$$$tra? Never again.
Was charging our customer $119 for 100/20 plan last year. After talking to their customer service immediately gave a $4!!!! discount and raised speed to 500/50.
Another customer, just last month, was charged by Telstra $109 for 50/20 connection plus $10 McAfee subscription a month. Now that customer paying same $ for 1000/100 connection.
[mitty] Thinking of doing this for the 1000/100, but wondering how peoples experience churning is… generally with other ISPs you place an order and it pretty much happens within 10-20 mins, in the experience of others is that the same with Telstra these days? Also if you then churn out before the four months is up, do you need to call them to cancel the service lest you be charged or does that happen automatically?
[Panama] Hmm telstra $49 for 4 or Origin $55 for 6?
[bAps] i've never had any problems with origin, been with them twice now (once on HFC, once on FTTP).
[mugs5000] pretty sure you just get another plan and they do it all
[dna level c] Does anyone else aside from Superloop pull this crap?
[aqsz200] just contact Telstra for cancelling
they said get a nbn with another provider, provide them the nbn id
Telstra will auto cancel yours once another provide connects you
[camr00] I churned from Telstra to Neptune a few months ago.
Signed up on Neptune, they transferred the service. I got the final bill from Telstra automatically (and it was accurate to the day I churned) and then a month later I got sent an email to ask for the modem back.
[sandman20104159] ohh look its the normal price that NBN should be that every other NBN charge normally!
[killergreely] I'm still on the massive high I got from leaving them 3 years ago.
[hawktalk] You'd like them to also reward loyalty and give better discounted deals for those of us that have been with them for xx years but noooooooooooooooooooooooooooooo.
[Tinqer] First time I've ever even vaguely considered adding Telstra into the churn cycle.
Anyone know what they're like for CGNAT?
[celery juice] Telstra doesn't use CGNAT, only dynamic IP. You can pay extra for static IP too.
[tellhimhesdreaming] Hmmm, it's gotta be better service (the NBN itself, not the customer service…) than the amaysim deal I'm on.
Thanks OP
[prankster] yeah im on the amaysim $50 for 6 months but just only started in Aug.
Would like to hop onto this plan but not sure if we can put a future date for activation so i can wrap up with amaysim and then after go with telstra
[ElectricMallet] How far in advance can the connection date be scheduled? Waiting for the $250 finder gift card from Optus nbn before the next churn.
[dna level c] In my experience 30 days is about the max. But you could sign up for this one at the end of November when the deal expires and have a connection date for the end of the December.
[dorikin] Thanks - this is what I’m planning to do
[dna level c] Good deal.
Luckily my current offer expires near the end of this month, and this deal expires at the end of the month.
I'll wait to pull the trigger and see if any of the other good players make a better offer, I'd like to see a better price and at least 6 month duration.
[gamer9119] How likely is there going to be another NBN deal to port out to in March after the 4 months?
Does Telstra allow future connection date? Mine runs out end December. Thanks
[prankster] im sure theres always going to be some offer by some ISP
[Sunford] Can I get the free modem/router from Telstra?
[camr00] No longer 'free' - you have to pay an additional fee per month for the modem/cellular backup to be included (or you can buy outright and skip the 24 month plan). Price of both no modem, and plans with a modem are reduced by 50%. So nbn500 WITHOUT modem is $49/mth for 4 months, then $99/mth ongoing. nbn500 WITH modem is $56/mth for 4 months and then $113/mth ongoing.
